ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 92% low-intensity dark pigment with localized high-intensity white clusters at the distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white contiguous geometric clusters mapped to the far-left and far-right distal margins. Sparse white point-source speckling distributed across the lower-mid sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point and an estimated interior pixel angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitudes vary from 5-15 pixels with non-uniform peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory initiating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward convex sweep at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonizations) localized on the outer margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct dark linear disruption visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the upper-left margin towards the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; one dark diagonal linear mark/scar on the left lobe.
